label: architecture
name: Architecture Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR architecture image into one or more detailed categories based on the building's purpose, design, historical significance, and structural type.

labels.residential: An image primarily showing a residential building such as a house, villa, apartment building, or housing complex.
labels.commercial: An image primarily showing a commercial building such as an office, shopping mall, hotel, restaurant, or retail complex.
labels.religious: An image primarily showing a religious structure such as a temple, church, mosque, monastery, shrine, or synagogue.
labels.industrial: An image primarily showing an industrial building such as a factory, warehouse, power plant, refinery, or manufacturing facility.
labels.public_building: An image primarily showing a public or government building such as a courthouse, library, hospital, police station, or municipal office.
labels.educational_building: An image primarily showing a school, college, university, training institute, or other educational building.
labels.historic_building: An image primarily showing an old, historic, heritage, or traditional building such as a palace, fort, castle, or preserved structure.
labels.monument: An image primarily showing a monument, memorial, statue, arch, or commemorative structure.
labels.bridge: An image primarily showing a bridge, flyover, viaduct, suspension bridge, or pedestrian crossing structure.
labels.tower: An image primarily showing a tall structure such as a skyscraper, observation tower, clock tower, lighthouse, or communication tower.
